definitions.explanation: Intense, visible fire or flames. A more dramatic and literary word than 炎, often used in technical, literary, or compound terms.

examples.japanese: {火炎|かえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{火炎|かえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: The building was engulfed in flames.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消防士|しょうぼうし}→消防士：05057_shouboushi⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{火炎|かえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{懸命|けんめい}→懸命：00216_kenmei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{消火活動|しょうかかつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: The firefighters continued their firefighting efforts amid the intense flames.

notes:
A more dramatic or technical synonym of ⟦{炎|ほのお}→炎：03724_honoo⟧. Composed of {火|か} (fire) + {炎|えん} (flame). Often found in compound words and technical terms rather than everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火炎|かえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to be engulfed in flames
- {火炎|かえん}{放射器|ほうしゃき}: flamethrower
- {火炎瓶|かえんびん}: Molotov cocktail; fire bomb
- {火炎|かえん}⟦{土器|どき}→土器：09658_doki⟧: flame-style pottery (Jomon-era pottery with flame-like decorations)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{炎|ほのお}→炎：03724_honoo⟧: flame — the standard everyday word for flames
- ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧: fire — the most basic and general word
- ⟦{炎上|えんじょう}→炎上：05867_enjou⟧: going up in flames; also used figuratively for online backlash

CULTURAL NOTE:
{火炎|かえん}⟦{土器|どき}→土器：09658_doki⟧ is a famous type of Jomon-period pottery with elaborate flame-shaped rims, discovered mainly in Niigata Prefecture. It is considered a masterpiece of prehistoric art.
